title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Notices Sent on a Case
content:
This standard lists the notices a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case generates and when each one goes out.

**(a) Due-and-payable notice and options letter.**

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "On the day the loan is called due, and in no case later than the plan's due-and-payable notice days after it, a due-and-payable notice and a successor options letter go to each recipient named by the plan's notice recipients, by the plan's delivery method; the options letter lists the plan's intent options and the response window." This wording has been superseded by the current basis.

**(b) Default notice.** A default notice goes to the borrower when a property charge or property condition case opens. It starts the plan's default notice cure days.

**(c) Foreclosure referral notice.** A foreclosure referral notice goes to the recipients at least the plan's foreclosure referral notice days, in calendar days, before any referral.

**(d) Extension letter.** An extension letter goes out on each granted extension.

**(e) Cure confirmation.** A cure confirmation goes out when a case is cured.

**(f) Contact before successor confirmation.** For a deceased borrower's loan, a caller who is not yet a confirmed successor in interest receives only the list of documents in the plan's successor documents. This follows the plan's setting on communication before confirmation.

**(g) Once per date.**

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "Each notice type goes to each recipient once per date." This wording has been superseded by the current basis.

## Notice quick reference

| Notice | Goes to | Occasion |
|---|---|---|
| default notice | the borrower | a property charge or property condition case opens |
| foreclosure referral notice | the plan's recipients | at least the plan's referral notice days before a referral |
| extension letter | the plan's recipients | each granted extension |
| cure confirmation | the plan's recipients | a case is cured |
| document list only | a not-yet-confirmed caller on a deceased borrower's loan | any contact before confirmation |

## Hypothetical illustration

A referral is planned for an invented 20 October under a plan whose referral notice figure is 30 calendar days. A referral notice sent on 20 September satisfies item (c). A notice sent on 25 September does not.

superseded_clauses: On the day the loan is called due, and in no case later than due_and_payable_notice_days calendar days after it, a due_and_payable_notice and a successor_options_letter go to each recipient named by the plan's notice_recipients, by notice_delivery_method; the options letter lists the plan's intent_options and the response window.
Each notice type goes to each recipient once per date.
